title: Text another user wrote runs as script in a customer's page

source.says: the census's reading: output contexts need different treatment, and safe text sinks, validated URLs and audited HTML sanitization are not interchangeable (S21); Trusted Types constrains values entering injection sinks through explicit policies (S27)

claim: charter §8.2 (escaping is the default); `html.raw_html` performs `unsafe.raw_html`, and reaching it needs an audited capability with a justification (PW5010)

repro.how: T09's store notice, which staff post, rendered with Svelte's `{@html}` so that its formatting shows; the repair renders it as text, `{data.notice}`, which Svelte escapes

pleris.faithful: The same notice, on the same store (T09's setup), rendered through `html.raw_html`: refused, naming the capability and the escaped alternative. Its neighbour is T09's `{notice}`, escaped by default.
